summary_1line: A Brahmana seeking spiritual knowledge meets the Naga Padmanabha, who describes cosmic wonders of the Sun and a mysterious radiant being approaching Surya.

image_candidates.scene_text: A radiant celestial being blazing like a second sun tears through the sky and approaches Surya while the sun-god stretches out his hands in welcome.
The Brahmana Dharmaranya sits in meditation on the banks of the Gomati, reciting the Vedas while patiently awaiting the Naga Padmanabha.
The Naga Padmanabha respectfully greets the waiting Brahmana, bowing and speaking gentle words beside the quiet riverside grove.
